title: AlgoTrace task instance v2
description: One task instance, one JSON object per line of instances/<series>.jsonl (protocol design.md, section 3). Generated once before a stage of the study, one file per stage; the environment, the reference algorithms and the analyzer read the same file, so no module has to repeat a random generator. Lines in the order task (sort, hanoi, search), n ascending, rep ascending.

instance_id.description: Unique in the file, e.g. sort-n10-r03.

series.description: Stage the file belongs to; every configuration of the stage reads the same file.

idx.description: Number of the line in the file from 0; seed = base_seed + idx and fault_seed = base_fault_seed + idx.

n.description: Size (size of the protocol): array length (sort, search) or number of disks (hanoi).

rep.description: Repetition of the cell (task, n) from 0: every repetition has its own instance (for Hanoi the same content with another instance_id).

seed.description: Seed the instance was generated from (base_seed + idx); null for a hand-made instance.

generator.description: Generator name, version (generator_version of the protocol) and base seeds, the same in every generated line of a file; null for a hand-made instance. The state below, not the seed, is the instance.

base_fault_seed.description: Base of the fault schedules, different from base_seed; null when the file has no cell with faults.

initial_state.description: Initial hidden state; in search it holds the target (target of the protocol).

target_present.description: Search: the target is in the array; null for other tasks.

answer.description: Search: the reference answer, the position of the target or -1; null for other tasks.

fault_schedule.description: Schedule of the injected fault for a cell of the condition faults (sort N = 10, Hanoi n = 4 in the protocol); null for other lines.

checks.description: Checks of solvability and correctness written by the generator (protocol design.md, section 3); a series does not start when failed is not empty. permutation = the values are 1..N, not_sorted = the array is not sorted, hanoi_start = n disks on peg 0, strictly_increasing = the search array grows strictly, target_present and answer agree with the array. null for a hand-made instance.

allOf.description: A generated instance has its seed and its checks, a hand-made one neither.
